Interpretation of witness result: 1) Observations: Simulator predicted S in [1.81, 1.87]; ibm_fez measured S in [1.328, 1.406] (+/-0.09), reflecting expected ~25% noise degradation while decisively exceeding the separable bound S<=1 by >3.5 sigma across all 3 pairs. 2) Assumptions & limits: The bipartite conjugate witness S=<ZZ>+<XX> strictly certifies non-separability under fair projective sampling, proving the QPU preserved quantum entanglement through the connectome unitary generator e^{-iLt}. However, this certifies step 1 only; physical multi-step noise dilation (r>=2) remains simulated. 3) Relation to Kopel: This serves as a methodological demonstration bridging classical Markov forgetting to quantum channels (PPT certified bound n_EB >= 7), not biological quantum computation or advantage. 4) Recommendation: Synthesize both the classical pruning boundary traps and quantum channel metrics into docs/walkthrough; no further hardware jobs needed.
